title: Participation
subtitle: Set discussion board visibility (who can view), scroll down to set who can edit board information, and then set participation and moderation with channels.
channelDescription: This channel controls who can add, view, and moderate posts on this discussion board.
addChannelsDescription: Channels control who can add posts to the board. They can be open to groups, an organization, or the public, and can be applied to many discussions. Channels also control who can moderate. Set blocked words for auto-moderation within a channel.
privateChannelDescription: You cannot see the private channel assigned to this discussion board. You can remove the channel and select an existing channel or create a channel.
removeChannelConfirmationMessage: This discussion board will no longer display posts. You can add a channel if this channel is removed.

removed.title: Channel removed
removed.message: Choose or create a channel for participation.

error.title: Failed. The channel was not set.

viewGroups.description: People who can view (but not post to) the board; posting is set by channels below.

editGroups.description: Group members can edit board information in the workspace.

aboutChannelsNotice.title: Introducing channels
aboutChannelsNotice.message: Channels are not groups, but can contain them. They determine who can post and moderate.

nonPrivateChannelNotice.title: Cannot edit channel
nonPrivateChannelNotice.message: Only moderators of this channel can edit it. Contact channel owner or org admin to add, if required. You can also remove this channel, add an existing one (of which you are a moderator), or create a new one.

privateChannelNotice.title: Cannot edit channel
privateChannelNotice.message: Only moderators of this channel can edit it. Contact channel owner to add, if required. You can also remove this channel, add an existing one (of which you are a moderator), or create a new one.

participate.header: Who can participate and who can moderate
